name: Lyra, Tolarian Archangel
description: An Echoverse angel and headmaster of the Tolarian Academy who raised Traxos and rebuilt it as a guardian.

relations.note: Lyra rebuilt the engine as a defender.
relations.quote: Lyra rebuilt the engine as a mighty defender of Tolaria
